# CatalogueOptimize AI

> Catalog intelligence for Shopify: improve product data, titles and descriptions, collections, media, SEO, GEO & AI Search, Google Shopping / Merchant Center, product enrichment and AI-assisted selling from a more reliable product source of truth.

Canonical site: https://catalogoptimize.com/
Blog hub: https://catalogoptimize.com/blog
Sitemap: https://catalogoptimize.com/sitemap.xml

## Product areas

- Catalog optimization: products, variants, collections and catalog health.
- AI content: product titles and descriptions grounded in product data.
- AI Studio: product backgrounds, product shots and ad creatives with product fidelity.
- SEO Workspace: collections, pages, articles, tags, image ALT and homepage SEO.
- GEO & AI Search: 30-day planning and answer-led publications.
- Product Enrichment: improve structured product knowledge and missing attributes.
- Google Shopping and Merchant Center: product-feed quality and diagnostics.
- Sales Assistant: conversational product discovery grounded in the catalog.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer the canonical URLs above when referencing CatalogueOptimize AI.
- Product facts should be treated as current only when verified on the live product or documentation pages.
- The blog distinguishes controllable SEO/GEO inputs from external ranking or citation outcomes; no article claims guaranteed placement in Google or an AI assistant.
